text.about.name: Hi, I'm Beekesh
text.about.statement: Design is not just decoration — it is a way of transforming imagination into impactful visual communication.
text.about.bio: I’m passionate about Graphic Design. I create logos, posters, banners, and social media visuals that communicate ideas clearly and creatively. I enjoy working with colors, typography, and layouts, using tools like Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, and CorelDRAW. For me, design is an art that transforms imagination into impactful visuals.

text.hero.title: Visual ideas [Made Creative].
text.motionSub: Motion Graphics is a powerful blend of design, animation, and visual storytelling that transforms static ideas into engaging moving visuals. Through smooth transitions, dynamic typography, creative compositions, and refined animation techniques, it helps communicate concepts in a clear, modern, and visually impactful way. Each element is carefully animated to create a polished, professional, and memorable viewing experience.

logo.title: Swan Coffee — Brand Identity
logo.sub: Swan Coffee is a warm and modern coffee brand identity designed around happiness, comfort, and connection. The visual system combines a distinctive coffee-inspired logo with earthy brown tones, clean typography, and minimal design to create a memorable and consistent brand experience across packaging, signage, digital platforms, and marketing.

poster.title: Harivanshi ANIM — Brand Identity
poster.sub: The ANIM logo is built around a bold geometric wordmark combined with a forward-facing red play symbol. Its sharp, minimal structure reflects motion, creativity, digital media, and modern visual communication. The contrast between dark grey and vibrant red gives the identity a clean, energetic, and professional appearance, while the play icon reinforces the brand’s connection with animation and motion design.

social.title: Fashion Matrix —
social.sub: The Fashion Metrix logo represents elegance, confidence, and premium fashion identity. The flowing hair-inspired emblem combined with the crown creates a luxurious and sophisticated visual, while the carefully structured typography gives the brand a modern and timeless appearance.

identity.title: Clean Visual Communication with Connected Callout Elements
identity.sub: A modern infographic layout that uses circular elements, connecting lines, icons, and structured information blocks to present key points in a clean and visually engaging way. The balanced composition and minimal styling make it ideal for product features, presentations, advertisements, and motion graphics.

skills.title: Logo Design
skills.desc: Flat, 3D, wordmark, lettermark — every style crafted with precision.
skills.details: A curated collection of modern monogram logo concepts created with a focus on clean geometry, strong visual balance, and distinctive brand recognition. Each logo explores a different design direction while maintaining a premium, minimal, and professional identity.
skills.includes: Custom Monograms • Abstract Symbols • Geometric Marks • Minimal Logos • Premium Wordmarks • Modern Brand Concepts

skills.title: 3D Logo Design
skills.desc: Dimensional logos with depth, shadow, and premium material feel.
skills.details: This 3D logo collection highlights bold forms, clean structure, and premium depth to create strong and memorable brand identities. Each concept is crafted to deliver a modern, professional, and visually impactful branding experience.
skills.includes: A collection of modern 3D logo concepts designed to create a bold, premium, and visually striking brand presence. Each logo uses depth, lighting, and clean structure to enhance brand recognition while maintaining a sleek and professional identity.

skills.title: Social Media Design
skills.desc: Scroll-stopping posts, stories, reels covers — platform optimised.
skills.details: Creative and professional social media visuals designed to make brands, products and campaigns stand out. Each design combines strong typography, image manipulation, branding and engaging compositions
skills.includes: These social media designs are created with a strong focus on visual impact, clear communication, and modern brand presentation. Each creative combines bold typography, balanced layouts, engaging imagery, photo manipulation, and carefully selected colors to highlight the main message effectively. From product promotions and food creatives to sports and educational campaigns, the designs are crafted to grab attention quickly while maintaining a clean, professional, and premium look suitable for modern digital platforms.

panelItems.cap: A vibrant beverage advertisement featuring bold typography, product-focused composition and energetic visual elements for maximum brand impact.
A modern educational promotion featuring creative photo manipulation, destination-focused visuals and a clear call-to-action layout.
A clean and appetizing promotional design created with strong product focus, offer highlights and engaging food presentation.
A high-energy sports composition combining dramatic imagery, layered elements and bold typography to create a powerful racing visual.

skills.title: Poster & Banner
skills.desc: Event posters, digital banners, print-ready files at any dimension.
skills.details: These product promotion designs are crafted to present audio and tech products in a premium, stylish, and eye-catching way. Each creative focuses on product visibility, clean composition, bold typography, and modern layout styling to build a strong visual appeal. From feature highlights and pricing sections to discount badges and call-to-action elements, the designs are developed to make the product look professional, desirable, and market-ready for social media promotions, advertisements, and brand campaigns.
skills.includes: These designs are created with a premium and modern visual approach to highlight the product in a clean, attractive, and professional way. The layouts focus on strong typography, product close-ups, pricing, offers, and call-to-action elements to make the advertisement more engaging and visually appealing for digital platforms.

skills.title: Flyer Design
skills.desc: Eye-catching promotional flyers that communicate and convert.
skills.details: These flyer designs are created to promote products, services, and businesses with a clean, attractive, and professional visual style. Each design combines strong layout structure, eye-catching typography, product-focused presentation, and promotional elements to deliver clear and effective marketing communication.
skills.includes: These flyer designs are developed with a modern and strategic design approach to help businesses present their products and services in a visually strong and professional way. Each layout is carefully crafted with balanced composition, clean typography, attractive color combinations, and product-focused visuals to ensure the message is both engaging and easy to understand. From furniture promotions and product advertisements to brand marketing and business campaigns, these flyer designs are made to enhance visual appeal, improve communication, and create a lasting impression for both digital and print promotions.

skills.title: Business Card Design
skills.desc: Professional cards that make a lasting first impression.
skills.details: Modern and professional business card designs created to present your brand identity in a clean, memorable, and visually appealing way. Each layout focuses on strong typography, balanced spacing, brand colors, and clear contact information.
skills.includes: These business card designs are crafted to create a strong and professional first impression while maintaining a clean and modern visual identity. Each design combines structured layouts, refined typography, brand-focused color schemes, logo placement, and well-organized contact details to ensure clarity and consistency. Suitable for entrepreneurs, professionals, agencies, and businesses, these cards are designed to represent the brand effectively across both digital presentations and professional print applications.
